ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var raw = attributes.queryParams.Product_ID default null var asArray = if (raw == null or raw == "") [] else if (raw is Array) raw else (raw as String) splitBy "," --- asArray map ((trim($ as String))) filter ((v) -> v matches /^\d+$/)

%dw 2.0 output application/java var fromDate = attributes.queryParams.fromDate default "" var toDate = attributes.queryParams.toDate default "" var dbName = attributes.queryParams.Database default "" var page = (attributes.queryParams.PageNumber default "1") as String --- if (fromDate == "" or !(fromDate matches /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/)) "fromDate is required as YYYY-MM-DD" else if (toDate == "" or !(toDate matches /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/)) "toDate is required as YYYY-MM-DD" else if (dbName == "" or !(dbName matches /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/)) "Database is required and must be a valid schema name" else if (!(page matches /^\d+$/) or ((page as Number) < 1)) "PageNumber must be a positive integer" else null

%dw 2.0 output text/plain var schema = vars.Database var ids = vars.productIds default [] var productFilter = if (sizeOf(ids) > 0) (" AND a.product_id IN (" ++ (ids joinBy ",") ++ ")") else "" var offset = ((vars.PageNumber as Number) - 1) * (vars.pageSize as Number) --- "SELECT a.SHOPID AS STOREID, a.USERID AS SalesRepID, b.routeid AS RouteID, a.product_id AS ProductID, '???' AS DistributorID, a.Supplier_id AS WarehouseID, a.SALE_ORDER_ID AS OrderNumber, a.Entry_ID AS InvoiceNumber, DATE_FORMAT(a.Created_AT, '%d/%m/%Y') AS InvoiceDate, DATE_FORMAT(a.Created_AT, '%H:%i:%s') AS InvoiceTimepart, a.Payment_Status AS InvoiceStatus, a.packaging AS UnitOfMeasure, 'KES' AS Currency, a.quantity AS QuantityInvoiced, a.value_sold AS AmountInvoiced, '???' AS Discount, '???' AS VATAmount, a.Entry_Type AS TransType FROM " ++ schema ++ ".bi_salesmaster AS a LEFT JOIN " ++ schema ++ ".bi_customer_visits AS b ON a.VisitID = b.visitid WHERE a.Created_AT BETWEEN :fromTs AND :toTs" ++ productFilter ++ " ORDER BY a.Created_AT, a.Entry_ID LIMIT " ++ (vars.pageSize as String) ++ " OFFSET " ++ (offset as String)
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { fromTs: vars.fromDate ++ " 00:00:00", toTs: vars.toDate ++ " 00:00:00" }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "success", endpoint: "Sales", pageNumber: vars.PageNumber as Number, pageSize: vars.pageSize as Number, count: sizeOf(payload default []), data: payload default [] }
